metadata.description: Cascade model fitting for retinal recordings, in the CascadeGraph parameterization, with a data contract every recording must satisfy before it is fitted

plugins.name: ln-fitting-procedure
plugins.description: Fitting and debugging parametric cascade models of neural stimulus-response data -- LN, GLM with feedback, two-arm -- in the CascadeGraph parameterization. A recording declares its sampling interval, response units and array layout up front, and the loader checks that declaration against the file before spending a fit on it: a response left in volts, or an array stored transposed, does not error -- it quietly fits the wrong thing and never shows up in R^2. Staged Nelder-Mead pipeline with random restarts, free-running feedback, per-epoch variance explained, and automatic diagnostics that catch the failure modes a good R^2 hides.
